title: The Sun
body:
# A star nearby
The Sun is a **star**: a ball of hot gas that makes its own light.

- It holds 99.8 % of the solar system's mass.
- Its light takes about *8 minutes* to reach Earth.

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | Yellow dwarf |
| Age | about 4.6 billion years |

A `<script>` in lesson text is shown as text, never run.

title: The inner planets
body:
# Rocky worlds
The four inner planets are rocky.

1. Mercury
2. Venus
3. Earth
4. Mars

Venus is the **hottest**, because its thick air traps heat.

title: The outer planets
body:
# Giants
Jupiter and Saturn are **gas giants**; Uranus and Neptune are **ice giants**.

Saturn's rings are made mostly of ice.
